invariants: Forking never mutates or overwrites the parent world.
A descendant keeps the fingerprint of the parent seed from which it branched.
A descendant receives its own Seedhouse baseline with explicit inherited-record provenance.
Worldseed inheritance separates what must survive from what may change or be lost.
Continuity Genome changes alter the Worldseed fingerprint.
Records become canon only through an explicit Canon Carry action.
Canon becomes inheritable only through an explicit Seedhouse rooting action.
Replay reports fingerprint mismatch rather than rewriting expected history.
Possible Worlds comparisons can be receipted without mutating either compared branch.
Exact .worldseed import verifies reconstruction and never overwrites an existing world id.
Binary Ark entries are SHA-256 verified before materialization in the desktop store.
Ark reconstruction retains lineage references and source Seedhouse record ids.
Seed Library planting preserves source world and source Worldseed fingerprint and begins as Germinating.
Cross-world Seed Library planting never overwrites the target world's own identity or existing Seedhouse records.
Lineage graph integrity reports dangling parents and ancestry cycles.
Threshold Detector may prepare a branch draft but never creates a branch automatically.
